notes:
## Changes

- **A tidier folder menu.** Right-clicking a folder now shows its options in groups: opening and playing; the folder's details, name and cover; sharing and moving; upkeep; and Delete on its own at the bottom. The four cover options are together under **Cover**, with clearer names: Pick from the screenshots, Pick a frame from the videos, Choose one for me, and Remove cover. Optimise screenshots, Rebuild all screenshots and Check files for damage are under **Screenshots and files**.
- Every item now has an underlined letter for the keyboard (press Alt to see them). D is only used for Delete.
- Remove cover is greyed out when a folder has no cover.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
